name: vscode-sepalith
description: Inline next-edit suggestions for R files from a local llama.cpp sidecar running the Sepalith arm A GGUF (PRM03 prompt contract zeta2-prm03-v1).

sepalith.modelPath.description: Absolute path to a GGUF. Empty: download and use the arm A Q8_0 GGUF (scholzmx/sepalith-2b-edit-sft, folder arm-a, sha256-pinned, 2.7 GB) into the shared Sepalith cache. Other qualified tiers of the same model: Q6_K (arm-a-imat-Q6_K.gguf, smallest tier that passed the C09 quant gate) and Q4_K_M-mixA-e4 (quant autoresearch); set their path here. The model must be trained on the zeta2-prm03-v1 prompt.

sepalith.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the llama-server binary.

sepalith.contextSize.description: Server context window (tokens). A request needs its prompt plus the 1,024-token generation cap; prompts are bounded by the 6,000-unit source window plus the recent edit.

sepalith.postAcceptCooldown.description: After accepting a suggestion, suppress the next auto-trigger until your next keystroke (the acceptance insertion itself does not re-trigger).

sepalith.debounceMs.description: Idle ms before an automatic suggestion attempt; 0 disables auto-trigger (manual only).

sepalith.warmup.description: Prefill-as-you-settle: ~200 ms after an edit, cursor move, file switch or accepted suggestion, send the next request's exact prompt token IDs with zero generation so the server's prompt cache is warm when the suggestion is requested. Off = every suggestion request pays its own prefill.

sepalith.allowNoEdit.description: Let the model answer [NO_EDIT] (shown as no suggestion). Off: when the model's answer is a no-op, ask for its best edit instead (the no-op's first token is banned for the first step only).

sepalith.speculative.description: N-gram speculative decoding (--spec-type ngram-simple, n 2, m 4): about 1.4x faster warm suggestions, but outputs are not token-identical to plain greedy decoding (failed the lossless gate). Applies at the next server start.

sepalith.debugMode.description: Log the full rendered PRM03 prompt and raw completion for every request.

sepalith.manifestUrl.description: HTTPS URL of a validated Sepalith release manifest. Downloads runtime and model into the shared Sepalith cache.

sepalith.backend.description: Managed runtime backend. Auto probes Vulkan on Windows/Linux and uses Metal on macOS; CPU is the fallback.

sepalith.gpuLayers.description: GPU layers for a manually configured server. Managed runtimes select this automatically.

scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run bundle
